Keep this page for your reference
Parade Date & Parade Time— Friday - December 5, 2025 @ 7:00 p.m.

Entries will start line-up at Wayland Nursing Home &Continue onto King Street, Mary Knoll Lane, & onto Southern Drive. Southern Drive will be one-way traffic entering at the lower end (Ontario way of the street). There will be Parade Personnel working in the area to help guide everyone into their locations as well as numbered stakes marking the locations. This is an evening parade & lighted decorations will be essential on entries such as vehicles, floats, etc. Judging on all entries will be based in part upon decorations and lighting. YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO HAVE ASANTA CLAUS IN YOUR ENTRY. The only Santa in the parade will be at the end. We don't want to confuse the children. To allow everyone to enjoy music, singing and so bands can be heard, please do not blow any horns or sirens from the time you line up until the end of the parade.  Thank you for abiding by these guidelines to help keep everyone safe and to have an enjoyable parade!
Entry Judging Criteria and Guidelines (0–5-point scale for each area listed.)
Big Rigs— Emergency Vehicles — Show Vehicles – Tractors
